capabilities: replace text within the selected text or current line
search using plain text or regular expressions with flags
trigger the replacement via command or hotkey
configure the find and replace patterns in plugin settings
extras: Replacements must be preconfigured in the plugin settings rather than entered at run time; the README includes regex examples for heading and link rewrites.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to find and replace text limited to a selected portion of a note.
summary: Text find-and-replace tool that runs on the selected text (or the current line) using plain text or regular expressions.
